data.title: A2 · 维修室的灯
data.description: A2 换下战斗装，穿着宽松衬衫坐在维修台边，低头检查手臂上的擦痕。工具放在一旁，她暂时没有去拿。
data.promptProse: Seated beside an oily hydraulic maintenance bench in a dim subterranean bunker, A2 uses a small laser soldering tool to weld a battle scrape on her synthetic forearm under a single swinging incandescent work light. Shelves of scavenged machine parts, dangling hydraulic hoses, and oil stains on the steel decking frame her solitary, self-reliant repair routine.
data.animaCaption: The repair tools remain on the bench beside her. The workbench lamp lights her face, arm and the tools around the repair room.
